sentences.text: The evidence does not show any gold-loan-specific pre-payment penalty or charge for this bank, so the exact penalty cannot be stated from the materials provided.
For a UCB, the residual rule says that in cases other than the specific exceptions, pre-payment charges, if any, are to be as per the approved policy of the UCB.
The bank’s policy only defines “foreclosure” as pre-payment of the loan in full, and it does not state any penalty amount or rate.
